STATS.TITLE: Your online stats
STATS.EMPTY: Play an online room match to start your stats.
STATS.DISCLAIMER: Only online room matches count. Stats are self-reported and unverified.
STATS.SAVE_FAILED: Couldn't save your stats for this match.

LOCAL.DESCRIPTION: A second person shares this keyboard. By default they use WASD and Space and you use the arrow keys and Enter; change both in Settings.
LOCAL.NAME: Player 2

GAMES.TITLE: Games
GAMES.EMPTY: No games right now. Start one!

CPU.TITLE: Versus CPU
CPU.DESCRIPTION: Practice against computer opponents on your own.
CPU.NAME: CPU {number} · {difficulty}

ONLINE.TITLE: Online rooms
ONLINE.DESCRIPTION: Create a room or join one, then share its name with friends.
ONLINE.UNAVAILABLE: Online rooms aren't configured in this build, but CPU matches still work.

LOBBY.NEED_PLAYERS: Waiting for at least {count} online players.
LOBBY.SHARE_HINT: Share the room name “{room}” so friends can join.
LOBBY.SEATS_FULL: All {count} seats are taken. Anyone else watches.
LOBBY.COUNTDOWN_HINT: Four players starts a 30-second countdown. Each additional player adds 5 seconds. Dropping below four cancels the countdown. Online rooms have no CPU opponents.

CONNECTION.ERROR: Lost connection to the room. Retrying… check your network.

MATCH.SUDDEN_DEATH: Sudden death! The arena is closing in.
MATCH.WAITING_FOR_HOST: Waiting for the host to start the next round…
MATCH.SPECTATING: You're watching this round. You'll get a seat in the next one if one is free.

LEADERBOARD.TITLE: Online leaderboard
LEADERBOARD.DESCRIPTION: Top 50 lifetime players by wins, then players soaked. Player codes protect account details.
LEADERBOARD.ERROR: Rankings could not be loaded. Try refreshing.
LEADERBOARD.UNAVAILABLE: Online rankings aren’t configured in this build. You can still play offline.

HOME.TAGLINE: Drop balloons. Soak rivals. Stay dry.
HOME.ONLINE_HINT: 4–8 players · No CPUs · Matches start automatically after the countdown.
HOME.NO_ROOMS: No rooms yet. Create one and invite your friends.
HOME.GOAL: Drop water balloons, collect power-ups and be the last player dry.
HOME.RULE_SPLASH: Balloons pop after 2.5 seconds in a plus-shaped splash. Crates stop the splash; other balloons trigger chain reactions.
HOME.RULE_POWER_UPS: Break crates to find extra balloons, bigger splashes and faster feet. Stay out of every splash, including your own.
HOME.RULE_SUDDEN_DEATH: After two minutes, the arena starts closing in. The last player dry wins.

DEVICE.TITLE: Desktop required
DEVICE.DESCRIPTION: Balloono does not support mobile devices. Please play on a desktop or laptop with a keyboard and a browser window at least 1024 pixels wide.

SETTINGS.TITLE: Settings
SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Choose your keys. Click a key, then press the new one, or press Escape to cancel.
SETTINGS.LOCAL_PRIORITY: Player 2 keys apply in local 2-player matches and the practice arena, where they take priority over Player 1's matching keys.

CONTROLS.TITLE: Controls
CONTROLS.DESCRIPTION: Use these keys to move and drop balloons. Change them with the gear button in-game or Key bindings in Settings.

PRACTICE.DESCRIPTION: Try the controls together in this mini arena. Move around, drop water balloons, break crates and collect power-ups. Your current key bindings apply.
PRACTICE.FOCUS: Click the arena or choose Try controls to play.
PRACTICE.ACTIVE: Controls active · Escape or click outside the arena to pause.
